faqs.a:
Land-use fees shall be charged by the community development department for services
               associated with each such fee and shall be payable to the city at the time of application
               or, if none, as otherwise provided in this code or directed by the city. Land-use
               fees shall be reviewed and updated as deemed necessary by the community development
               department and determined in accordance with a fee schedule adopted by the city council
               by resolution.
